privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Detailed information on personal data processing and the use of Google OAuth in App Actriskell.
privacy.s1Intro: The App Actriskell platform is managed by the Triskell Cultural and Sports Association (A.C. Triskell). For any inquiries regarding privacy or the processing of your personal data, you may contact the administrative officer via email at:
privacy.s2Title: 2. Personal data collected via Google OAuth
privacy.s2Intro: To access App Actriskell via Google Sign-In (Google OAuth 2.0), we request exclusively the basic identity permissions necessary to verify your account:
privacy.s2Item1Text: used to display your identity within your internal member, student, or instructor profile.
privacy.s2Item2Text: used as a unique identifier to verify that you have been previously authorized by the association's administration and to assign your corresponding role (Administrator, Instructor, or Student).
privacy.s2Item3Text: if your Google account provides a public avatar image, it may be displayed in your internal user or instructor record.
privacy.s2Outro: We do not request access to your Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, contacts, or any other private data from your Google account.
privacy.s3Intro: Your name and email address obtained through Google OAuth are used solely and exclusively for:
privacy.s3Item1Text: validating your identity and enabling secure access to your private portal within App Actriskell.
privacy.s3Item2Text: linking your account with your workshop enrollments, class schedules, attendance logs, fee receipts, and instructor payouts, where applicable.
privacy.s3Item3Text: displaying internal association notices and notes within the application.
privacy.s4Title: 4. Commitment not to share with third parties
privacy.s4P1: App Actriskell does not sell, rent, transfer, or share your personal data or information obtained via Google OAuth with third parties, external companies, advertising networks, or data brokers. Nor is your data used for commercial, profiling, or targeted advertising purposes.
privacy.s4P2: The application's technical storage operates on secure cloud infrastructure (Supabase / PostgreSQL) under strict Row Level Security (RLS), ensuring that each user only accesses information permitted according to their authorized role within A.C. Triskell.
privacy.s5Title: 5. Security, local cache, and optional biometrics
privacy.s5P1: All communications between your browser and our servers are encrypted via HTTPS/TLS protocol. Optionally, users may enable device biometric unlock (WebAuthn / Passkeys) to avoid re-entering credentials; biometric data never leaves your device nor is it sent to our servers.
privacy.s6Intro: We retain your data only for as long as you maintain your relationship as a member, student, instructor, or administrator of the association. At any time, you may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, or objection, as well as revoke access linked to your Google account from your Google security settings or by writing to

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Rules for access and responsible use of the App Actriskell association management platform.
terms.s1P1: These Terms of Service govern access to and use of the App Actriskell web application, developed for the administrative, teaching, and membership management of the Triskell Cultural and Sports Association (A.C. Triskell). Accessing or using the platform implies acceptance of these terms.
terms.s2P1: App Actriskell is a private internal management tool. There is no open self-registration for the general public: only individuals whose email address has been previously authorized by the Association's Administration may sign in (either via Google OAuth or assigned credentials).
terms.s2P2: Each user is responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their session and using the application exclusively in accordance with their assigned role (Administrator, Instructor, or Student/Member).
terms.s3Intro: The user agrees to make diligent and lawful use of the platform, refraining from:
terms.s3Item1: Attempting to access data, workshops, or financial records belonging to other members or instructors without authorization.
terms.s3Item2: Altering, deleting, or tampering with attendance records, payments, or global settings without holding administrative or instructor permissions over such records.
terms.s3Item3: Introducing malicious code, conducting unauthorized load tests, or interfering with the normal operation of the service.
terms.s4Title: 4. Recording of fees, attendance, and notices
terms.s4P1: Information regarding schedules, activity fees, recorded attendance, instructor Bizum details, and receipts displayed in the application is for informational and internal administrative control purposes for the association. In the event of a discrepancy in a receipt or settlement, bank statements or agreements formalized with the Administration of A.C. Triskell shall prevail.
